violations.why: Once isr 2 has been enabled by an earlier zenith run, indigo (higher priority) can preempt a later zenith run between the two writes and read the intermediate value 0.
After zenith enables isr 2, indigo can preempt the task between the clear of v_quartz[9999] and the later write of 1. It then reads the intermediate value, because v_willow is 1.
